description: chat.rs handle_chat_set: for each Direct create, calls backend.get_objects::<Chat>(&account_id, None, None) to fetch all chats and scan for a duplicate contactId. Two problems: (1) O(n*m) where n = existing chats, m = creates in this request — on a large account with many creates this fetches the entire chat list m times; (2) the snapshot is taken inside the loop so two concurrent Chat/set requests with the same contactId can both pass the check and both succeed, creating duplicate direct chats. The dedup check should be done once before the create loop on a single fetched snapshot, and even then a concurrent race is only avoidable at the storage layer.
title: Chat/set direct-chat dedup fetches all chats per create — O(n*m) and races
